subject.title: feat(ui): full-page New session screen with gateway folder browser

question: Should `operator.admin` clients enumerate directories anywhere readable by the gateway process, or must `fs.listDir` be restricted to configured agent workspaces or explicit approved roots?
rationale: The repository has a narrower workspace-aware path-probe precedent, but tests cannot decide whether unrestricted host-directory metadata disclosure is an accepted permanent gateway contract.

options.title: Restrict to approved roots
options.body: Limit browsing to configured agent workspaces or explicit allowed roots, preserving a smaller disclosure boundary.

options.title: Approve unrestricted admin browsing
options.body: Keep arbitrary readable paths at `operator.admin` and explicitly document, test, and accept the metadata disclosure.

options.title: Remove host browsing
options.body: Land the full-page new-session UX while retaining typed paths until a narrower filesystem API is designed.

recommendation.title: Restrict to approved roots
recommendation.body: Limit browsing to configured agent workspaces or explicit allowed roots, preserving a smaller disclosure boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing session/worktree behavior and are the strongest history-backed owner for this product and security choice.
